description:
Why does money grow faster the longer you leave it alone? A short, chart-driven look at compound interest: the math, the history, and the one rule that matters most.

Key points: growth on growth, the Rule of 72, and why time beats timing.
title: $100 Becomes $1,147. Here's How.

scenes.narration: One hundred dollars. Fifty years. No extra deposits.
At five percent a year, it grows to about eleven hundred and forty seven dollars.
scenes.heading: After 50 years at 5%

scenes.narration: Because every year, your interest earns interest too.
A thousand dollars becomes sixteen hundred, then twenty six hundred, then over seven thousand.
scenes.heading: $1,000 at 5%

scenes.narration: The rules: start early, reinvest, and never interrupt it. Follow for more money math.
scenes.heading: The rules
